seoTitle: Pretty Little Liars Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Pretty Little Liars test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Spencer, Aria, Hanna, Emily, Alison, Mona, Caleb or Ezra — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the overachiever, the it girl, or the one quietly keeping everyone's secrets? Answer 12 everyday questions about friendship, secrets and keeping your cool, and find out which Pretty Little Liars character you are.

characters.name: Spencer Hastings
characters.title: The Overachiever
characters.summary: Clever, driven and competitive about everything. You do it properly, or not at all.
description: Like Spencer, you hold yourself to impossibly high standards. She's the smartest of the Liars, and she works hard to live up to her parents' expectations.
You lead from the front. Spencer is the group's natural leader, and she's usually the first to work out what's really going on.
You're competitive, even at home. Spencer has a long-running rivalry with her older sister, Melissa.
characters.flaw: You'd rather stay up all night than admit you need a break.
characters.signature: A colour-coded planner and a plan B for your plan B.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn everything into a competition, and win

characters.name: Aria Montgomery
characters.title: The Free Spirit
characters.summary: Artsy, romantic and true to yourself. You'd rather be interesting than fit in.
description: Like Aria, you have your own style. She's the alternative one of the group, and she came back to Rosewood after a year living in Iceland.
You follow your heart, even when it's complicated. Aria fell for her English teacher, Ezra, and they had to keep it a secret.
You can keep a secret when it matters. Aria hid her father's affair for a long time, and she and Ezra get married in the end.
characters.flaw: You keep secrets to protect people, and it usually backfires.
characters.signature: Statement earrings, a notebook full of ideas and a romance nobody approves of.
characters.clashReason: they'd follow their heart, whatever the rules say

characters.name: Hanna Marin
characters.title: The It Girl
characters.summary: Fierce, funny and fabulous. You say what everyone's thinking, and you look great doing it.
description: Like Hanna, you know how to make an impression. She's the group's diva, and she became the most popular girl at Rosewood High after Alison disappeared.
You're tougher than you look. Hanna gets through her parents' divorce and her mum's money problems, and never loses her sense of humour.
You love hard. Hanna and Caleb are one of the show's steadiest couples, and they end up married.
characters.flaw: You speak first and think about it afterwards.
characters.signature: A killer outfit, a sharp comeback and Caleb on speed dial.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you exactly what they think of your outfit

characters.name: Emily Fields
characters.title: The Loyal Heart
characters.summary: Sweet, loyal and braver than you realise. You wear your heart on your sleeve.
description: Like Emily, you're kind to the core. She's the sweetest of the Liars, and the star of the Rosewood swim team.
You're honest about who you are. Emily's feelings for Alison help her realise she's gay, and she comes out to her friends and family.
You're loyal to a fault. Emily never stops caring about Alison, and the two of them end up engaged.
characters.flaw: You give second chances to people who've already used up their first.
characters.signature: A swim bag, a warm hug and your heart on your sleeve.
characters.clashReason: they'd forgive the people you're furious with

characters.name: Alison DiLaurentis
characters.title: The Queen Bee
characters.summary: Charming, clever and always in control. You know everyone's secrets, and exactly what they're worth.
description: Like Alison, you're the one everyone wants to be around. She was the queen bee of Rosewood High and the leader of the group.
You know how to keep people in line. Alison collected her friends' secrets and used them whenever it suited her.
You always have a plan. Alison vanished and was presumed dead, then turned out to have been alive the whole time.
characters.flaw: You treat other people's secrets like currency.
characters.signature: A knowing smile and a little black book of everyone's secrets.
characters.clashReason: they'd find out your biggest secret and keep it, just in case

characters.name: Mona Vanderwaal
characters.title: The Mastermind
characters.summary: Clever, ambitious and never, ever forgets. You went from overlooked to unstoppable.
description: Like Mona, you know what it's like to be left out. Alison mocked her, and she longed to be part of Alison's group.
You reinvent yourself. After Alison vanished, Mona and Hanna had makeovers and became the most popular girls in school.
You play to win. Mona was revealed as 'A', and by the end of the show she's in France, still playing the game, and winning.
characters.flaw: You never forgive being left out, and you make sure people pay for it.
characters.signature: A perfect outfit, a secret plan and a collection of very creepy dolls.
characters.clashReason: they'd be sweet to your face while plotting against you

characters.name: Caleb Rivers
characters.title: The Laid-Back Hacker
characters.summary: Calm, loyal and quietly brilliant. You can fix almost anything, and you never make a fuss about it.
description: Like Caleb, you've had to look after yourself. He grew up in foster care, and he arrives in Rosewood as the bad boy.
You're quietly brilliant. Caleb is a skilled hacker, and his computer skills help the girls track down 'A'.
You stay steady when everyone else panics. Caleb becomes Hanna's boyfriend, and later her husband.
characters.flaw: You keep your feelings so quiet that people forget to ask how you are.
characters.signature: A laptop, a beanie and a fix for whatever just broke.
characters.clashReason: they'd stay totally calm while you're freaking out

characters.name: Ezra Fitz
characters.title: The Romantic Writer
characters.summary: Bookish, romantic and a little bit mysterious. You fall hard, and you keep your cards close.
description: Like Ezra, you love a good book. He's Aria's English teacher at Rosewood High, and he later teaches at Hollis College.
You're a hopeless romantic. Ezra's secret relationship with Aria is one of the show's biggest storylines.
You keep things close to your chest. Ezra has more secrets than anyone suspects, but he and Aria end up married, and they even write a book together.
characters.flaw: You keep so many secrets that people start wondering what else you're hiding.
characters.signature: A stack of old books, a strong coffee and a love story you're still writing.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep secrets from you and call it protecting you

questions.text: Your friends want to do group costumes for a party. You...

options.text: Take charge of the outfits. Nobody else can be trusted with this
Suggest something weird and arty that nobody else would think of
Push for characters from a classic novel
Wear whatever they hand you. You're easy

questions.text: You've got a big test tomorrow, and you haven't started revising. You...

options.text: Panic, make colour-coded flashcards and study until 2am
Doodle in the margins of your notes until you finally get going
Stay calm. You'll figure it out on the day
Find out exactly what the top student is studying, and study that

questions.text: You find out a secret about someone who's been mean to you. You...

options.text: Keep it. You never know when it'll come in handy
Save it for when it'll hurt the most
Let it go. Using it would make you as bad as them
Tell your best friends immediately

questions.text: You've fallen for someone you really shouldn't. You...

options.text: Go for it anyway, and keep it secret
Promise yourself you'll stop, then write them a love letter
Tell them honestly how you feel, even though it's scary
Make a list of reasons it's a bad idea, then ignore it

questions.text: Your laptop crashes the night before a deadline. You...

options.text: Fix it yourself. It'll be running again in ten minutes
Rewrite the whole thing from memory overnight
Call the friend who's good with computers. Or cry. Or both
Switch to a notebook and pen. You prefer it anyway

questions.text: You're new at school, and the most popular girl invites you to sit with her. You...

options.text: Accept. You've waited your whole life for this
Say yes, but bring your friend along too
Thank her, then go and sit with the interesting kids in the corner
Sit on your own. You don't need anyone's approval

questions.text: Someone posts an embarrassing photo of you online. You...

options.text: Post something even better within the hour. Nobody wins against you
Smile, then make sure whoever did it regrets it
Laugh it off in public, then cry about it later
Track down who posted it, and have it taken down by dinner

questions.text: Your friends want a big night out, but you've got loads of work to do. You...

options.text: Stay in and work. You'll celebrate once it's done
Go out. Work can wait. Fun can't
Stay home with a good book and an old film
Go out, and make sure you're the one everyone's talking about

questions.text: You find out someone in your family is hiding something huge. You...

options.text: Keep their secret, even though it's eating you up
Dig until you know the whole truth, then confront them
Let them know you know. Now they owe you
Give them time. They'll tell you when they're ready

questions.text: You find out a friend has been lying to you for months. You...

options.text: Feel betrayed, but give them a chance to explain
Act like you don't know, and plan your next move
Tell them you understand. You know what it's like to have to hide things
Write them a long, angry message, then never send it

questions.text: You start getting anonymous messages from someone who knows all your secrets. You...

options.text: Investigate. You'll find out who it is, whatever it takes
Stay calm. You know exactly how this game is played
Tell your friends straight away. You're stronger together
Disappear, and let everyone think you're gone for good

questions.text: Your best friend vanished a year ago, and everyone thinks she's dead. Suddenly, she's back. You...

options.text: Ask why she couldn't at least have sent a text
Quietly check whether her story actually adds up
Ask how she pulled it off. You're impressed
Hug her, smile, and start worrying about your spot
